title: More ways to answer assessments
summary: Submit videos and documents as assessment answers while keeping your learning history.

changes.text: Answer assessment questions with a video upload or recording.
Upload PDF, Word, or PowerPoint assessment answers up to 20 MB.
Previous video assignments and reviews are retained in assessment history.

title: Read and listen in your course
summary: Lessons now include documents and audio alongside video.

changes.text: Read PDF, Word, and PowerPoint lessons in the course without downloading a file.
Mark a file lesson as read to save your progress.
Listen to audio lessons in the course player.

title: A more open learning experience
summary: Create your learner account, stay signed in, and keep up with improvements to your learning workspace.

changes.text: Create an account with Google or sign up with email and verify your address.
Sessions renew in the background so you can keep learning without frequent sign-ins.
Private lessons clearly show when access from your instructor is needed.
Browse versioned release notes and revisit the full update history from What’s new.
